findings.detail: The reviewed test module docstring (lines 15-17: '(c) Dropbox CN 688031 FY2024 annual -> REUSED_EXACT, canonical under the Dropbox root') and the preflight wu card (C2(c) line 31 + Annex line 42) still describe journey (c) as REUSED_EXACT canonical-in-Dropbox. The implemented test test_c2_journey_dropbox_fail_closed_incomplete_sample asserts FAIL-CLOSED MISSING with capture_incomplete trace and download_required=True, which matches the genuine production-data state (source_url is http, not https -> not capture-ready -> MISSING; verified independently in the catalog DB). The implementer receipt honestly discloses the fail-closed behavior (ZR409-IMPL-002); only the docstrings/card were not updated. Documentation-only inconsistency; behavior is correct and matches the review brief's expectation.

findings.detail: Independent analysis of the production catalog: 378 distinct annual_report contents under dropbox_stock, 325 content-shared with company_raw, 53 exclusive to dropbox. Of the 53 exclusive, only 2 carry http:// source_urls (星环 2024 pdoc 1223325316 and 星环 2025 pdoc 1225028771); the other 51 exclusive annuals have NO source_url in document metadata (also not capture-ready). So 'the Dropbox root's only exclusive annuals are http or shared with companies' is loose (51 no-url exclusives exist), but the substance holds: no dropbox-exclusive annual is currently a capture-ready REUSED_EXACT candidate, and the 星环 2024 fail-closed is genuine production-data truth (verified by my own sqlite query: http source_url, capture-incomplete).
findings.title: Card parenthetical on Dropbox exclusive annuals is imprecise but substantively holds
